title: The beach mod
description: A new dimension, mobs, tools, food. The mod's theme is based on the beach and similar themes, with elements of magic and the history of the dimension itself.
body:
This minecraft mod adds a new dimension in which you can find new blocks, creatures, tools and much more

Now you will need to craft a new portal activator and find the material itself for the transition to a new dimension

Most of the creatures in the mod you can cook and eat, some creatures are needed to craft new items for battles or construction

Walk and carefully look into the mini-reservoirs, if you want to find new creatures and treasure chests

The mod features a story that you have to uncover as you walk around the world and explore the old houses of the previous owners, but they have long since turned into stone statues

The mod itself is intended for recreation or for playing together with friends

Don't forget to download Geckolib
